# Plan Canvas

Curated by Skill Harbor: a review loop for plans and visual artifacts where you write the artifact and the human reviews it in the browser, annotating the exact element they mean, chatting, and delivering an Approve plan or Request changes verdict, while the agent blocks on a single CLI call that returns the feedback as JSON. Built for the moments when feedback like "move this, change that" is easier pointed at than typed: reviewing designs, comparisons, reports, or any local markdown or HTML artifact. The canvas serves local artifact files only, never remote URLs, and the verdict replaces a typed "yes/proceed" at the plan confirmation gate. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: requires the ecc-plan-canvas CLI from the ecc-universal npm package installed on your machine (see prerequisites in the install prompt); local files only, not for code diff review or running web apps. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
